_: Lacuna Scheme's foreman verbs — the ONE description of what a worker may say. The supervisor test checks every verb defined in supervisor.mjs is here; the worker song (the brain's reference) is written from this file.

verbs.name: subscribe
verbs.does: Lacuna's metric arrives as an (on 'metric …) event every N seconds (at least 15).

verbs.name: on
verbs.does: Handle an event: a subscribed metric, 'hand (a read came back), 'brain (an answer), 'answer (a person's yes or no), 'child-report, 'child-graved.

verbs.name: every
verbs.does: A timer, at least 5 s apart.

verbs.name: after
verbs.does: One step of a plan, once, later (1 s to 7 days). It outlives a foreman restart when its procedure is a top-level define — (after 60 check), not (after 60 (lambda …)) — the checkpoint arms it again by name.

verbs.name: report
verbs.does: Up to the parent and to Lacuna; kind 'alert raises one of Lacuna's alerts.

verbs.name: mail
verbs.does: A letter to Claude under ~/lacuna-world/mail/to-claude/ (3.0 §7.6): kind self-report | ticket | handoff-note, what, evidence. The same what from one sender within an hour raises a count, no new file. Nobody is woken.

verbs.name: remember
verbs.does: Keep a value in the worker's own memory; it survives restarts.

verbs.name: recall
verbs.does: A remembered value, or default.

verbs.name: get
verbs.does: A value out of an event's alist — (get r 'ok), (get r 'result).

verbs.name: take
verbs.does: The first n items.

verbs.name: sort-by
verbs.does: Rows (alists) sorted by a key, biggest first ('up for smallest first). Never write your own sort.

verbs.name: hand
verbs.does: Ask Lacuna for a READ; the answer arrives as (on 'hand (lambda (r) …)) with r's ok, op, result. It has 120 s: unanswered, it is sent once more, then (on 'hand-timeout (lambda (x) …)) hears x's ticket, op, tries — a program with no such handler is stopped, "<op> never answered". Ops: repos · git-status PATH · git-log PATH N · branches PATH · disk-usage PATH · files PATH GLOB (inside ~/code and ~/lacuna-world) · tail-log SOURCE N (our own logs by name: dev-api, vite, foreman, jobs, brain, brain-gateway; result has lines) · read-zst PATH N SKIP (a .zst corpus; result has lines) · battery-last (the latest True State battery run: pass, acts, reds, shots) · battery-status RUN (one run: running or done; reds and shots when done) · codemap NAME (a package's CODEMAP.md by its folder name; result has text) · cart-record NAME (a cart's run record: runs, done, stopped, mean seconds, the last run) · outline FILE (a source file's definitions with line numbers, not its text) · scripts (drafted scripts against the forbidden patterns) · doc-drift (paths our docs name that no longer exist) · hand-times (the slowest hands, p50/p95) · ui-times (the desk's frame times by card) · box-cost (one 0–1 load score with advice) · cold-links (the cortex's links going cold) · cloud-review CART (the cloud seat reviews a cart and its runs; faults named, or why it rests) · cloud-plan FILE [GOAL] (numbered steps from a file's outline, never code) · cloud-wiki FILE (a doc page drafted from a module's outline and docstring; result has draft, a path under cloud-drafts) · cloud-merge FILE (a conflicted file's hunks → a proposed resolution per hunk, drafted, never applied) · self-repair-check (each self-repair's check now — brain, gateway, foreman, small-minds, lacuna — and the newest repairs; repairing is the chat's self_repair act) · cloud-mocks PLATFORM DOC (mock routes drafted from a public docs page saved in ~/lacuna-world/public-docs) · form-probe (synthetic listings through the Shopkeeper's judge: cases, held, mismatches) · eye-tree TARGET (the page the eye holds as its parts: role, words, box as fractions; act on one with the eye's steer pick N) · release-sort (the curator repo's changed paths sorted by rule: branch, ours, generated, scratch, unsure, unit_tests, untested, subject). Starting the battery is an ask (run-battery), never a hand. The box, through Lacuna's own API (hands_api.py): overview · disk · disk-eaters · services · service · service-log · watchdogs · alerts · errors · jobs · carts · cart-run · builds · release-board · release · health · mocks · devices · escalations · minds · roles · recall · work · battery-runs · caliper · eye · sentinel · petitions · owner-here · brain · usage · drills — e.g. (hand 'disk), (hand 'service "dev-api"), (hand 'recall "why did the release stop"). Lacuna's graph cortex (the Rust store): memory WORDS (recall with the newest-wins trail) · pointing-at KIND/KEY (everything pointing at it) · like KIND/KEY [K] (nearest by meaning) · since 6h|ISO (what arrived) · fading [HOURS] (links going cold) · trail KIND/KEY (breadcrumbs). The vote: knn MIND WORDS → {label, confidence} by the nearest labeled pairs (EmbeddingGemma), no trained model.

verbs.name: need-brain
verbs.does: Ask Lacuna to think; the answer arrives as (on 'brain (lambda (text) …)). Rationed: use rarely. In a cart the first argument is one of its judgment points: (need-brain 'new-thing "is this a problem?" line) — any other point is refused.

verbs.name: spawn
verbs.does: A child worker running program (slat text written in THIS program — never text that arrived later); it reports to this worker as 'child-report. Its verbs are a subset of this worker's: '(report hand) narrows them, asking for more is refused.

verbs.name: file
verbs.does: Files a run under its key (3.0 §7.2): a run already running under that key is returned, never filed twice. The run is a worker with its own contract; its tools are the header's hands and acts. Answers the run's id; the foreman tells Lacuna 'filed with the trigger and evidence.

verbs.name: send-to
verbs.does: An event to another worker by id.

verbs.name: work-order
verbs.does: A work order in the desk's queue, the record the desk's work-order verb writes (desk-verbs.mjs): the goal in one or two sentences, and who it is for: judge (a diagnosis, postmortem or plan for the 26B), engineer, coder or cart. Answers the order's id, or #f with the refusal as the worker's thought. A host that names no desk folder files nothing.

verbs.name: ask
verbs.does: File a permission card; the yes or no arrives as (on 'answer …). Only act-tier workers.

verbs.name: act
verbs.does: Do one of the cart's named ACTS (its header's (acts . (…))): pass · promote-build · install-ipad · clean-listed (the files on the owner's disk list, nothing else). Only on a run the owner pressed; a dry run answers what it would do. The answer arrives as (on 'act (lambda (r) …)) with r's ok, op, job (follow it with (hand 'job ID)) or would, or why.

verbs.name: mind-job
verbs.does: Declare, at load, a job for the foreman's small mind: what it is asked, the only keys of an event it may see (:needs), the labels it may give, the verbs it may choose (a subset of this worker's; never one that writes code), and whether what it reads is untrusted (then it may choose no acting verb).

verbs.name: mind
verbs.does: Hand the job's slice of value to the small mind. It answers under a grammar of the job's verbs and labels only; the answer arrives as (on 'mind (lambda (r) …)) with r's job, ok, form, verb, label. A chosen verb runs as this worker's own call; anything outside the grammar is dropped and counted.

verbs.name: stop
verbs.does: Retire this worker.

verbs.name: done
verbs.does: A cart's done-condition is met: it retires — children and timers stop, its run's artifact is written and its exam row moves. Only a cart has it; a plain worker uses (stop).

verbs.name: lacuna-cart
verbs.does: A cart's header — its FIRST form, read as data before anything runs. See `cart`.

verbs.name: now
verbs.does: Seconds since 1970.

verbs.name: my-name
verbs.does: This worker's name.

verbs.name: my-gen
verbs.does: This worker's generation: 1 at spawn, one more at each restart.

verbs.name: my-slot
verbs.does: This worker's index in the foreman's table at spawn; a resume keeps it.

verbs.name: display
verbs.does: A note on the worker's last line (not a report).

verbs.name: newline
verbs.does: Nothing (kept for Scheme habits).

words: Build text with (string-append "low: " (number->string x)); `format` does not fill %f or ~a. No file, shell or web verbs exist: reads go through hand, changes through ask. Keep a worker SHORT — under 20 lines; one job. A hand's rows: repos have name, branch, dirty, ahead, behind, stashes, last_commit_days; disk-usage rows have path and mb (already biggest first); files rows have path and kb; branches rows have branch, days, merged.

examples.what: alert when free disk drops under 10 GB
every hour, list repos with more than 20 uncommitted files
examples.program:
(every 3600 (lambda () (hand 'repos)))
(on 'hand (lambda (r)
  (when (get r 'ok)
    (for-each (lambda (repo)
                (when (> (get repo 'dirty 0) 20)
                  (report 'alert (string-append (get repo 'name "?") " has " (number->string (get repo 'dirty 0)) " uncommitted files"))))
              (get r 'result '())))))

examples.what: say when the dev API goes down and when it comes back
examples.program:
(subscribe 'up:dev-api 30)
(on 'up:dev-api (lambda (up)
  (let ((was (recall 'up 1)))
    (remember 'up up)
    (cond ((and (= was 1) (= up 0)) (report 'alert "the dev API went down"))
          ((and (= was 0) (= up 1)) (report 'ok "the dev API is back"))))))

examples.what: every 6 hours, report the 3 biggest folders in ~/lacuna-world

cart._: A Lacuna cart (LACUNA-1.3-DESIGN §37.2): one file ~/lacuna-world/carts/<name>.sks whose first form is its header.
rules: The header names: does (one line), agent (tier watch|act and the ONLY verbs the body may call), minds (each: job class, labels, untrusted), judgment (the only points need-brain may name), touches (what it takes a lease on), done (its done-condition) and exam (its exam row, if any).
Job classes: signal->label · command->verb · output->route · template-fill · shell. The box picks each mind's model from the bench's tiers; never name a model.
A mind that reads the outside world (a log, a page, mail) is (untrusted . #t): it may only label, summarize or observe.
(define (start) …) runs once, when the cart first loads. (on 'mind (lambda (m) …)) gets m's job, ok, label and of (the slice the mind was shown).
When the done-condition is met, call (done "what was done"): the cart retires and leaves its artifact. Never leave it running.
A cart only reports; anything that changes a repo, a shop or a bug file is an (ask …) — a person's card.
cart.example:
(lacuna-cart 'disk-note
  '((does . "says once how full the disk is")
    (agent . ((tier . watch) (verbs . (subscribe on report done))))
    (done . "one reading reported")))
(subscribe 'disk_free_gb 60)
(on 'disk_free_gb (lambda (gb)
  (report 'disk (string-append "free: " (number->string gb) " GB"))
  (done "reported the free disk once")))
